description: Inserts or deletes a row/column of an existing table. The table is addressed by table_start_index — the table block's start index from read_document_text (its startIndex in get_document). action=insert_row adds next to the cell at row_index/column_index (insert_below, default true); insert_column likewise (insert_right, default true); delete_row / delete_column remove the row/column containing that cell WITH ALL ITS CONTENT — that content is unrecoverable. row_index/column_index are 0-based and default to 0. Deleting shifts every later index in the document; re-read before further edits.

action.description: What to do with the table.

document_id.description: The document id — the long id from the document URL (docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit) or from create_document output.

insert_below.description: insert_row only: insert below the anchor row (default true; false = above).

insert_right.description: insert_column only: insert right of the anchor column (default true; false = left).

tab_id.description: Tab to target (from list_tabs). Omit for the first/only tab.

table_start_index.description: The table's start index (the table block's start in read_document_text).

name: edit_table
title: Edit table rows and columns
